messages:
Maya: Quick design FYI — noticed in the table density PR that the inline action ellipsis is getting lost when row padding is reduced. People are missing delete / duplicate in tests.
Jon: Good catch. Can you paste a screenshot or a short vid? also which table variant (compact vs regular)? @Alex FYI.
Maya: Compact view, with checkboxes enabled. Screenshot shows ellipsis hugging the right edge and visually colliding with the checkbox column. Proposed options: 1) show a tiny ghost primary (edit) + ellipsis for rest, 2) increase ellipsis hit target and add visible outline on hover/focus.
Alex: I'm wary of always showing a primary action because it adds visual weight to dense tables. Option 1 could work if the primary is only shown for rows with actions. CSS idea: `min-width:32px; height:32px; padding:6px` for the icon btn to meet hit target without visually bloating the row.
Lina: Accessibility notes: target 44px for touch, but we can use 32px for desktop with clear focus styles. Make the ellipsis a real `<button>` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` states. Screen reader label should be descriptive: "More actions for <item name>".
Maya: Also the toasts for these actions are weird — they appear under the header and sometimes overlap sticky filter bar. Copy-wise they show single word verbs like "Deleted". Suggestion: consistent pattern: `<Action> <object> — Undo` (e.g., "Deleted 1 rule — Undo") and anchor to bottom-right for dense tables.
Jon: Do we have a token for toast offset when filters are sticky? I think there's `--toast-offset-y` but not sure it's used in table pages.
ops-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy.preview/snap/1234 (branch: feat/table-compact-ellipsismock).
Alex: Quick implementation note: for ghost icon we can visually keep it subtle: `.btn-ghost { min-width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; }` and increase hit area with inner padding. For ellipsis menu we can add `margin-right: -6px` to compensate.
Lina: Keyboard flow: Tab into row -> focus the first cell -> arrow to actions -> press Enter to open menu. We'll need JS focus traps if menu is in DOM order after row. Also ensure `role="menuitem"` for items.
Maya: Copy style: menu items should be sentence case, action first (verb) then object. Toasts: short phrase + undo link. Also consider how we announce toasts to SR — `role="status"` with polite announcement.
Jon: Can we do a 10-minute hallway usability with 5 folks? check discoverability and toast overlap.
Maya: I'll book 5 quick sessions. Meanwhile can someone mock the ghost primary + smaller icon ellipsis in the table? @Alex can you do mocks, @Lina add accessibility notes to the Figma page.
Alex: Yup. I'll push a quick mock branch `design/ellipsismock` in ~45m and attach screenshots to the PR.
Lina: I'll create an accessibility checklist in the Figma file and add recommended aria labels + keyboard notes.
Maya: Thanks all. After the mock + quick usability we'll pick an approach and decide if a spacing token tweak is needed (maybe a small token for action hit-target when in compact mode). :thumbsup:
